en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a large historic complex on a hill above a town and river. The complex combines a castle-like structure with many windows and steep roofs alongside tall Gothic cathedral towers with spires. Below the hill are smaller town buildings and riverside structures. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Meissen and labels the Albrechtsburg castle and the cathedral (Dom); part of the printed text has been crossed out by hand.
